Courts Reject Bail Pleas in Multiple Legal Cases

The Supreme Court and various High Courts have issued rulings on bail applications in separate legal matters. The Supreme Court rejected a plea by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) challenging the bail granted to Jaffer Sadiq, a former member of the DMK. In Jammu and Kashmir, the High Court denied bail to a former official, stating that the suppression of criminal antecedents constitutes an abuse of process. Additionally, the Meghalaya High Court rejected a bail application for a man accused of sexually assaulting a minor, with the court noting the betrayal of the child's trust. A separate report from Greater Kashmir also noted the High Court's refusal of bail to an accused in a minor girl's sexual assault case.
